summary: Revised plan successfully addresses the data-leakage issue identified in attempt 1. Feature set now contains only claim-intake-available attributes (clinical and administrative fields), eliminating the post-adjudication amount fields that were causing unrealistic model performance. Both models (logistic regression ROC-AUC 0.906, random forest ROC-AUC 0.887) show realistic performance levels for this imbalanced binary task. All required metrics (PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, precision and recall at top 5%) are reported, all artifacts are produced, and caveats appropriately document model limitations. The output is ready for sponsor handoff.
